defs.d: (of a thing) Having a low temperature.
defs.ex: A cold wind whistled through the trees.

defs.d: (of the weather) Causing the air to be cold.
defs.ex: The forecast is that it will be very cold today.

defs.d: Someone or something of importance.
Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatever; a thing of any kind; something or other.
defs.ex: I would not do it for anything.

defs.d: (with “as” or “like”) Expressing an indefinite comparison.
A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; for example, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.
defs.ex: Our family lives in town.

defs.d: An extended family; a group of people who are related to one another by blood or marriage.
defs.ex: 1915, William T. Groves, A History and Genealogy of the Groves Family in America

defs.d: Suitable for children and adults.
defs.ex: It's not good for a date, it's a family restaurant.

defs.d: Conservative, traditional.
defs.ex: The cultural struggle is for the survival of family values against all manner of atheistic amorality.

defs.d: A person belonging to a particular family; a close relative or relation.
A happy event, thing, person, etc.
Preceded by the: happy people as a group.
Often followed by up: to become happy; to brighten up, to cheer up.
Often followed by up: to make happy; to brighten, to cheer, to enliven.
An only child.
Alone in a category.
defs.ex: He is the only doctor for miles.

defs.d: Singularly superior; the best.
Without others or anything further; exclusively.
defs.ex: My heart is hers, and hers only.

defs.d: No more than; just.
defs.ex: If there were only one more ticket!

defs.d: True, accurate.
defs.ex: That is so.  You are responsible for this, is that not so?

defs.d: In that state or manner; with that attribute. A proadjective that replaces the aforementioned adjective phrase.
To the (explicitly stated) extent that.
defs.ex: It was so hot outside that all the plants died.  He was so good, they hired him on the spot.

defs.d: To the (implied) extent.
defs.ex: I need a piece of cloth so long. [= this long]

defs.d: In order that.
defs.ex: Eat your broccoli so you can have dessert.

defs.d: With the result that; for that reason; therefore.
defs.ex: He ate too much cake, so he fell ill.

defs.d: Coherent; well organized.
defs.ex: He's really together.

defs.d: At the same time, in the same place; in close association or proximity.
defs.ex: We went to school together.

defs.d: Into one place; into a single thing; combined.
defs.ex: He put all the parts together.

defs.d: Prior to some specified time, either past, present, or future; by this time; previously.
So soon.
defs.ex: Are you quitting already?

defs.d: Causing or able to cause fright.
defs.ex: She was hiding behind her pillow during the scary parts of the film.

defs.d: Uncannily striking or surprising.
defs.ex: Linda changed her hair, and it’s scary how much she looks like her mother.

defs.d: A 45 RPM vinyl record with one song on side A and one on side B.
A popular song released and sold (on any format) nominally on its own though usually having at least one extra track.
defs.ex: The Offspring released four singles from their most recent album.

defs.d: To identify or select one member of a group from the others; generally used with out, either to single out or to single (something) out.
defs.ex: Eddie singled out his favorite marble from the bag.

defs.d: To get a hit that advances the batter exactly one base.
defs.ex: Pedro singled in the bottom of the eighth inning, which, if converted to a run, would put the team back into contention.

defs.d: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.
defs.ex: Can you give me a single reason not to leave right now?

defs.d: Not divided in parts.
defs.ex: The potatoes left the spoon and landed in a single big lump on the plate.

defs.d: The act of observing; perception.
defs.ex: He took no notice of the changes, and went on as though nothing had happened.

defs.d: A written or printed announcement.
defs.ex: I always read the death notices in the paper.

defs.d: To remark upon; to mention.
To become aware of; to observe.
defs.ex: Did you notice the flowers in her yard?

defs.d: A burrow.
To ritualistically inter in a grave or tomb.
To place in the ground.
defs.ex: bury a bone;  bury the embers

defs.d: To perform the marriage ceremony for; to join in matrimony.
defs.ex: The priest wed the couple.

defs.d: To take as one's spouse.
defs.ex: She wed her first love.

defs.d: Marriage ceremony; ritual officially celebrating the beginning of a marriage.
defs.ex: Her announcement was quite a surprise, coming a month after she published the words "I hate weddings with a passion and a fury I can only partially explain rationally."

defs.d: Joining of two or more parts.
defs.ex: The wedding of our three companies took place last week.

defs.d: That which belongs to you (singular); the possessive second-person singular pronoun used without a following noun.
defs.ex: If this edit is mine, the other must be yours.  Their encyclopedia is good, but yours is even better.  It’s all yours.

defs.d: That which belongs to you (plural); the possessive second-person plural pronoun used without a following noun.
The distance measured along the longest dimension of an object.
Duration.
To lengthen.
To make (products or services) available for sale and promote them.
defs.ex: We plan to market an ecology model by next quarter.

defs.d: To sell
defs.ex: We marketed more this quarter already than all last year!

defs.d: Buying and selling in a market.
The promotion, distribution and selling of a product or service; the work of a marketer; includes market research and advertising.
(with present-tense constructions) First; beforehand, in advance.
(with past-tense constructions) At an earlier time.
In a strong or powerful manner.
defs.ex: In the third race, Renowned Blaze finished strongly to win, paying sixteen dollars.

defs.d: Very much.
defs.ex: His reply was strongly suggestive of a forthcoming challenge to the governor.

defs.d: A part or snippet of something taken or presented for inspection, or shown as evidence of the quality of the whole; a specimen.
defs.ex: a blood sample

defs.d: A subset of a population selected for measurement, observation or questioning, to provide statistical information about the population.
To take or to test a sample or samples of.
To reduce a continuous signal (such as a sound wave) to a discrete signal.
The land ruled by a count or a countess.

An administrative region of various countries, including Bhutan, Canada, China, Croatia, Ireland, Japan, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Romania, South Korea, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and 48 of the 50 United States (excluding Alaska and Louisiana).
Characteristic of a ‘county family’; representative of the gentry or aristocracy of a county.
An act of pointing out or noticing; notice or observation.
An expression, in speech or writing, of something remarked or noticed; a mention of something
defs.ex: a biting remark

defs.d: To make a remark or remarks; to comment.
To express in words or writing; to state; to make a comment
defs.ex: He remarked that it was getting late.

defs.d: (engraving) A small design etched on the margin of a plate and supposed to be removed after the earliest proofs have been taken.
(engraving) Any feature distinguishing a particular stage of the plate.
Alteration; change.
To change with time or a similar parameter.
defs.ex: He varies his magic tricks so as to minimize the possibility that any given audience member will see the same trick twice.

defs.d: To institute a change in, from a current state; to modify.
defs.ex: You should vary your diet. Eating just bread will do you harm in the end.

defs.d: An item's relative importance.
defs.ex: He set his e-mail message's priority to high.

defs.d: A goal of a person or an organisation.
defs.ex: She needs to get her priorities straight and stop playing games.

defs.d: Anything, such as a fence or border, that surrounds something.
To encircle something or simultaneously extend in all directions.
To enclose or confine something on all sides so as to prevent escape.
